verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI's CLI can run/load models (e.g., `local-ai run huggingface://...`), preload models via JSON, and auto-detects GPU backends, but there is no evidence of CLI flags or parameters for setting custom GPU offload (e.g., layer count) or context length when loading a model. Missing for 10: explicit CLI flags for GPU layer offload and context-size configuration, and any documentation/example showing these settings being passed at load time.
